cohort: 675 women who underwent cesarean section at Holy Family Hospital, Rawalpindi, Pakistan over a period of 2 months.
finding: The most common indications for emergency cesarean section were fetal distress (43.2%), followed by previous cesarean section (19.2%) and failure to progress (9.3%), while for elective cesarean section they were previous cesarean section (41%) and malpresentation (24.5%).
